meta.judge: blind tournament judge, lane TS2 round 2
meta.seed_note: one fresh seed per cell; every rule and reference row of a cell runs on the same paths; the stress rows of the primary reuse the same seed, hence the same paths
meta.close_construction: close = cumprod(1 + r) along time (close[:, 0] = 1); rules get close and rf (y10 only if a rule declares it in INPUTS; none does)
meta.hold3_note: hold 3x = run(r, rf, B = 3) with engine defaults, identical to the constant level 3.0

reference.note: constant levels do not depend on delay
